verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a processor. Letting users choose a storage region or data residency is an axis for cloud and SaaS services, so it is a category error for this product. The pack's on-device processing claims describe local compute, not a region-selection capability, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
